answer: An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The nadir counter is kept in copper and voyage shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 36 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
